entities.name: uS5 ribosomal protein
observations: The 171-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry B1VAD1 from Phytoplasma australiense.
uS5 is a structural component of the bacterial 30S small ribosomal subunit and contributes to translational accuracy with uS4 and uS12.
uS5 contacts uS4 and uS8 and stabilizes the conformation of the 30S head relative to the body.
The query contains Pfam Ribosomal_S5 PF00333.27 at residues 16-79 and Ribosomal_S5_C PF03719.22 at residues 91-162.

entities.name: uS5 sequence properties
observations: The protein is 171 amino acids long with estimated molecular mass 18.62 kDa and theoretical pI 10.58.
The predicted charge at pH 7 is strongly positive, approximately +21.7, consistent with nucleic-acid/rRNA association.
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: uS5 participates in translation as a structural constituent of the small ribosomal subunit.
Associated Gene Ontology biological processes include translation (GO:0006412) and ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254).

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: The curated cellular-component annotations place uS5 in the cytoplasm and in the small ribosomal subunit.
